newsitem.title: USA: North American bunkers rise on the East Coast.
newsitem.headline: North American bunkers rise on the East Coast.

text.p: North American bunker prices rose on the East Coast amid a kick up in demand and a tightening of supplies, but were stable late this week on the West Coast, players said on Thursday.
"Demand has been moderate in Houston and that has helped strengthen prices," said one East Coast player.
In Houston, spot 380 CST rose about $2 a tonne from Tuesday to between $88 a tonne and $89 a tonne. 180 CST was also up about $3 to $93/95 a tonne.
In New York, spot 380 CST edged up $2 to $98/99 a tonne, with 180 CST up $2 to $104/105 a tonne.
